definitions.C_active: post-hoc cumulative CPU-active nanoseconds plus GPU-active nanoseconds, converted to seconds; report CPU and GPU components separately
definitions.C_wall: post-hoc monotonic elapsed time from task request dispatch
definitions.prefix_rule: execute each arm to its full prescribed transition maximum, then truncate the closed timestamped trace at each cutoff; the scheduler receives no clock cutoff or stop signal
definitions.hit_rule: an assignment counts only after its generating charged expansion completes by the cutoff; initial assignment is separately reported at time zero, with curves including and excluding it

engineering_note: This log-spaced v01 grid is intentionally broad for the first local feasibility run. If nearly all completed traces fall outside the grid, preserve this version and issue v02 from a development-only runtime pilot before the next matched arm comparison.
